market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.2m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela was at ~988k bpd in March per OPEC-tracked CEIC data. Some sources claim ~1.2m bpd in April but OPEC secondary-source numbers tend to be more conservative. Hitting 1.2m in any single 2026 month is plausible but uncertain - depends on continued sanctions relief + investment.
assessment.key_uncertainty: OPEC MOMR figures often differ from other sources; political/sanctions environment volatile.
